description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of different relational association types evaluated in the MMRA benchmark, with each slice corresponding to a specific association category and its count and percentage of the total. The chart is divided into ten distinct slices, each labeled with its category name, count in parentheses, and percentage. Starting from the top and moving clockwise, the categories and their approximate proportions are: NearSameEntity (63, 6.34%), RelativePosition (81, 7.90%), MentalitySimilarity (89, 8.67%), SimilarEvent (90, 8.77%), AppearanceSimilarity (90, 8.77%), Layout (90, 8.77%), Environment (90, 8.77%), UsageSimilarity (100, 9.65%), SubEvent (100, 9.74%), and SimilarMaterial (106, 10.33%). The largest category shown is ObservationAngle (126, 12.28%). Each slice is colored differently, with labels positioned outside the pie for clarity. The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice and a legend is not explicitly shown but implied by the labels. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest at the top left.
